verses.en: But now they that are younger than I have me in derision, whose fathers I would have disdained to have set with the dogs of my flock.
verses.pt: Mas agora zombam de mim os de menos idade do que eu, cujos pais teria eu desdenhado de pôr com os cães do meu rebanho.
verses.en_web: “But now those who are younger than I have me in derision, whose fathers I would have disdained to put with my sheep dogs.
verses.en_bbe: But now those who are younger than I make sport of me; those whose fathers I would not have put with the dogs of my flocks.

verses.en: Yea, whereto might the strength of their hands profit me, in whom old age was perished?
verses.pt: Pois de que me serviria a força das suas mãos, homens nos quais já pereceu o vigor?
verses.en_web: Of what use is the strength of their hands to me, men in whom ripe age has perished?
verses.en_bbe: Of what use is the strength of their hands to me? all force is gone from them.

verses.en: For want and famine they were solitary; fleeing into the wilderness in former time desolate and waste.
verses.pt: De míngua e fome emagrecem; andam roendo pelo deserto, lugar de ruínas e desolação.
verses.en_web: They are gaunt from lack and famine. They gnaw the dry ground, in the gloom of waste and desolation.
verses.en_bbe: They are wasted for need of food, biting the dry earth; their only hope of life is in the waste land.

verses.en: Who cut up mallows by the bushes, and juniper roots for their meat.
verses.pt: Apanham malvas junto aos arbustos, e o seu mantimento são as raízes dos zimbros.
verses.en_web: They pluck salt herbs by the bushes. The roots of the broom are their food.
verses.en_bbe: They are pulling off the salt leaves from the brushwood, and making a meal of roots.

verses.en: They were driven forth from among men, (they cried after them as after a thief;)
verses.pt: São expulsos do meio dos homens, que gritam atrás deles, como atrás de um ladrão.
verses.en_web: They are driven out from among men. They cry after them as after a thief;
verses.en_bbe: They are sent out from among their townsmen, men are crying after them as thieves

verses.en: To dwell in the cliffs of the valleys, in caves of the earth, and in the rocks.
verses.pt: Têm que habitar nos desfiladeiros sombrios, nas cavernas da terra e dos penhascos.
verses.en_web: So that they dwell in frightful valleys, and in holes of the earth and of the rocks.
verses.en_bbe: They have to get a resting-place in the hollows of the valleys, in holes of the earth and rocks.

verses.en: Among the bushes they brayed; under the nettles they were gathered together.
verses.pt: Bramam entre os arbustos, ajuntam-se debaixo das urtigas.
verses.en_web: Among the bushes they bray; and under the nettles they are gathered together.
verses.en_bbe: They make noises like asses among the brushwood; they get together under the thorns.

verses.en: They were children of fools, yea, children of base men: they were viler than the earth.
verses.pt: São filhos de insensatos, filhos de gente sem nome; da terra foram enxotados.
verses.en_web: They are children of fools, yes, children of wicked men. They were flogged out of the land.
verses.en_bbe: They are sons of shame, and of men without a name, who have been forced out of the land.

verses.en: And now am I their song, yea, I am their byword.
verses.pt: Mas agora vim a ser a sua canção, e lhes sirvo de provérbio.
verses.en_web: “Now I have become their song. Yes, I am a byword to them.
verses.en_bbe: And now I have become their song, and I am a word of shame to them.

verses.en: They abhor me, they flee far from me, and spare not to spit in my face.
verses.pt: Eles me abominam, afastam-se de mim, e no meu rosto não se privam de cuspir.
verses.en_web: They abhor me, they stand aloof from me, and don’t hesitate to spit in my face.
verses.en_bbe: I am disgusting to them; they keep away from me, and put marks of shame on me.

verses.en: Because he hath loosed my cord, and afflicted me, they have also let loose the bridle before me.
verses.pt: Porquanto Deus desatou a minha corda e me humilhou, eles sacudiram de si o freio perante o meu rosto.
verses.en_web: For he has untied his cord, and afflicted me; and they have thrown off restraint before me.
verses.en_bbe: For he has made loose the cord of my bow, and put me to shame; he has sent down my flag to the earth before me.

verses.en: Upon my right hand rise the youth; they push away my feet, and they raise up against me the ways of their destruction.
verses.pt: ë direita levanta-se gente vil; empurram os meus pés, e contra mim erigem os seus caminhos de destruição.
verses.en_web: On my right hand rise the rabble. They thrust aside my feet, They cast up against me their ways of destruction.
verses.en_bbe: The lines of his men of war put themselves in order, and make high their ways of destruction against me:

verses.en: They mar my path, they set forward my calamity, they have no helper.
verses.pt: Estragam a minha vereda, promovem a minha calamidade; não há quem os detenha.
verses.en_web: They mar my path, They set forward my calamity, without anyone’s help.
verses.en_bbe: They have made waste my roads, with a view to my destruction; his bowmen come round about me;

verses.en: They came upon me as a wide breaking in of waters: in the desolation they rolled themselves upon me.
verses.pt: Vêm como por uma grande brecha, por entre as ruínas se precipitam.
verses.en_web: As through a wide breach they come, in the middle of the ruin they roll themselves in.
verses.en_bbe: As through a wide broken place in the wall they come on, I am overturned by the shock of their attack.

verses.en: Terrors are turned upon me: they pursue my soul as the wind: and my welfare passeth away as a cloud.
verses.pt: Sobrevieram-me pavores; é perseguida a minha honra como pelo vento; e como nuvem passou a minha felicidade.
verses.en_web: Terrors have turned on me. They chase my honor as the wind. My welfare has passed away as a cloud.
verses.en_bbe: Fears have come on me; my hope is gone like the wind, and my well-being like a cloud.

verses.en: And now my soul is poured out upon me; the days of affliction have taken hold upon me.
verses.pt: E agora dentro de mim se derrama a minha alma; os dias da aflição se apoderaram de mim.
verses.en_web: “Now my soul is poured out within me. Days of affliction have taken hold on me.
verses.en_bbe: But now my soul is turned to water in me, days of trouble overtake me:

verses.en: My bones are pierced in me in the night season: and my sinews take no rest.
verses.pt: De noite me são traspassados os ossos, e o mal que me corrói não descansa.
verses.en_web: In the night season my bones are pierced in me, and the pains that gnaw me take no rest.
verses.en_bbe: The flesh is gone from my bones, and they give me no rest; there is no end to my pains.

verses.en: By the great force of my disease is my garment changed: it bindeth me about as the collar of my coat.
verses.pt: Pela violência do mal está desfigurada a minha veste; como a gola da minha túnica, me aperta.
verses.en_web: By great force is my garment disfigured. It binds me about as the collar of my coat.
verses.en_bbe: With great force he takes a grip of my clothing, pulling me by the neck of my coat.

verses.en: He hath cast me into the mire, and I am become like dust and ashes.
verses.pt: Ele me lançou na lama, e fiquei semelhante ao pó e à cinza.
verses.en_web: He has cast me into the mire. I have become like dust and ashes.
verses.en_bbe: Truly God has made me low, even to the earth, and I have become like dust.

verses.en: I cry unto thee, and thou dost not hear me: I stand up, and thou regardest me not.
verses.pt: Clamo a ti, e não me respondes; ponho-me em pé, e não atentas para mim.
verses.en_web: I cry to you, and you do not answer me. I stand up, and you gaze at me.
verses.en_bbe: You give no answer to my cry, and take no note of my prayer.

verses.en: Thou art become cruel to me: with thy strong hand thou opposest thyself against me.
verses.pt: Tornas-te cruel para comigo; com a força da tua mão me persegues.
verses.en_web: You have turned to be cruel to me. With the might of your hand you persecute me.
verses.en_bbe: You have become cruel to me; the strength of your hand is hard on me.

verses.en: Thou liftest me up to the wind; thou causest me to ride upon it, and dissolvest my substance.
verses.pt: Levantas-me sobre o vento, fazes-me cavalgar sobre ele, e dissolves-me na tempestade.
verses.en_web: You lift me up to the wind, and drive me with it. You dissolve me in the storm.
verses.en_bbe: Lifting me up, you make me go on the wings of the wind; I am broken up by the storm.

verses.en: For I know that thou wilt bring me to death, and to the house appointed for all living.
verses.pt: Pois eu sei que me levarás à morte, e à casa do ajuntamento destinada a todos os viventes.
verses.en_web: For I know that you will bring me to death, To the house appointed for all living.
verses.en_bbe: For I am certain that you will send me back to death, and to the meeting-place ordered for all living.

verses.en: Howbeit he will not stretch out his hand to the grave, though they cry in his destruction.
verses.pt: Contudo não estende a mão quem está a cair? ou não clama por socorro na sua calamidade?
verses.en_web: “However doesn’t one stretch out a hand in his fall? Or in his calamity therefore cry for help?
verses.en_bbe: Has not my hand been stretched out in help to the poor? have I not been a saviour to him in his trouble?

verses.en: Did not I weep for him that was in trouble? was not my soul grieved for the poor?
verses.pt: Não chorava eu sobre aquele que estava aflito? ou não se angustiava a minha alma pelo necessitado?
verses.en_web: Didn’t I weep for him who was in trouble? Wasn’t my soul grieved for the needy?
verses.en_bbe: Have I not been weeping for the crushed? and was not my soul sad for him who was in need?

verses.en: When I looked for good, then evil came unto me: and when I waited for light, there came darkness.
verses.pt: Todavia aguardando eu o bem, eis que me veio o mal, e esperando eu a luz, veio a escuridão.
verses.en_web: When I looked for good, then evil came; When I waited for light, there came darkness.
verses.en_bbe: For I was looking for good, and evil came; I was waiting for light, and it became dark.

verses.en: My bowels boiled, and rested not: the days of affliction prevented me.
verses.pt: As minhas entranhas fervem e não descansam; os dias da aflição me surpreenderam.
verses.en_web: My heart is troubled, and doesn’t rest. Days of affliction have come on me.
verses.en_bbe: My feelings are strongly moved, and give me no rest; days of trouble have overtaken me.

verses.en: I went mourning without the sun: I stood up, and I cried in the congregation.
verses.pt: Denegrido ando, mas não do sol; levanto-me na congregação, e clamo por socorro.
verses.en_web: I go mourning without the sun. I stand up in the assembly, and cry for help.
verses.en_bbe: I go about in dark clothing, uncomforted; I get up in the public place, crying out for help.

verses.en: I am a brother to dragons, and a companion to owls.
verses.pt: Tornei-me irmão dos chacais, e companheiro dos avestruzes.
verses.en_web: I am a brother to jackals, and a companion to ostriches.
verses.en_bbe: I have become a brother to the jackals, and go about in the company of ostriches.

verses.en: My skin is black upon me, and my bones are burned with heat.
verses.pt: A minha pele enegrece e se me cai, e os meus ossos estão queimados do calor.
verses.en_web: My skin grows black and peels from me. My bones are burned with heat.
verses.en_bbe: My skin is black and dropping off me; and my bones are burning with the heat of my disease.

verses.en: My harp also is turned to mourning, and my organ into the voice of them that weep.
verses.pt: Pelo que se tornou em pranto a minha harpa, e a minha flauta em voz dos que choram.
verses.en_web: Therefore my harp has turned to mourning, and my pipe into the voice of those who weep.
verses.en_bbe: And my music has been turned to sorrow, and the sound of my pipe into the noise of weeping.
